values.note: Storm closure: 'Notice of Temporary Closure. This recreation site is temporarily closed because of potential storm-related impacts.' (posted during Hurricane Isaias, October 2026); the District's closures list also shows 'Dead River (campsite closed)'. No reopening date posted.

status.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/choctawhatchee-river-holmes-creek/dead-river-landing/ ('This recreation site is temporarily closed because of potential storm-related impacts.') + https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/recreation-site-closures/ ('The recreation sites listed below are temporarily closed: ... Dead River (campsite closed)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Free permit booked through the District's CampLife reservation system (a free account is needed, and availability shows only once logged in). Up to 7 nights per reservation; no more than two reservations at a time or in a 30-day period. Each site holds up to eight people and two vehicles.

booking.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/choctawhatchee-river-holmes-creek/dead-river-landing/ ('16 campsites that are available by reservation only', 'Each campsite has a capacity of eight people and two vehicles') + https://nwfwater.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Step-by-Step-Instructions-on-How-to-Make-A-Camping-Reservation.pdf ('A reservation can be made for up to seven (7) nights'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/choctawhatchee-river-holmes-creek/dead-river-landing/ ('The campsites do not have power, water, or waste disposal hookups.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Sites 1-8 take RVs, travel trailers and other camping vehicles; 9-16 are tent-only. CampLife lists every site as 50 x 50 ft, which looks like a default rather than a measured length, so no max rig length is recorded.

sites.source: https://nwfwater.com/lands/recreation/area/choctawhatchee-river-holmes-creek/dead-river-landing/ ('Campsites 1 through 8 are available by reservation for use with RVs, travel trailers, other camping vehicles, trailers and tents. Campsites 9 through 16 are limited to tent-only camping.'), read 2026-10-21

note: Northwest Florida Water Management District landing and camping area on Seven Runs Creek near where it joins Dead River, a slough off the Choctawhatchee River; about 16 miles south of Ponce de Leon off FL-81, then 2.3 miles east on Dead River Rd (graded dirt). Portable toilets, two day-use pavilions, playground, boat ramp. The access road can flood during moderate Choctawhatchee floods and the whole site during extreme ones. Site length is not published; check the site diagram before bringing a big rig. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the District page and CampLife: 16 reservation-only sites (1-8 for RVs/trailers), no hookups, 7-night limit, free. Added a temporary storm closure (site-page banner plus the District's closures list, October 2026). Note corrected (the landing is on Seven Runs Creek, not the main river), flood caveat added from the booking record, field facts dropped. Not stated: max rig length, season, potable water.
flags: Temporary storm closure recorded: site-page banner 'temporarily closed because of potential storm-related impacts' and the District's closures list ('Dead River (campsite closed)'), Hurricane Isaias, October 2026. Needs a re-check soon.

CampLife's RV site type lists travel trailer, fifth wheel, fold-down, van and tent but not MOTORHOME (the District page says sites 1-8 take 'RVs ... other camping vehicles'). Probably a booking-form omission, but a motorhome booking might be refused online.
Access is a 2.3-mile graded dirt road that 'can be flooded during moderate flood events' (CampLife park record).
